The build is green. Here's a summary of the change.

## Summary

Changed the `customerCode` format from `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (global sequence) to `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (per-city sequence).

**`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — reworked `nextCustomerCode`:
- Now takes `city` and `lastName`.
- `CITY3` = upper-cased first three letters of the city, `LAST3` = upper-cased first three of the last name.
- `NNNN` is now a **per-city** 4-digit zero-padded sequence: one more than the count of existing owners already in that city (case-insensitive match), instead of one more than the global owner count.
- Updated the call site and Javadoc accordingly (e.g. `SYD-SMI-0007`).

**`OwnerMapper.java`** — the membership number (`<customerCode>-M<YY>`) already derives from `customerCode`, so it automatically rebuilds on the new format; I only updated the Javadoc example to `SYD-SMI-0007-M26` to stay accurate.

The acceptance test `coreCustomerCodeHasCityPrefix`, which asserts the code matches `[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}`, passes — **BUILD SUCCESS**, 1 test run, 0 failures.
